scene: You skate across the wobbling bridge into an airy pagoda garden.
picture: Side-view on a mossy flagstone path. Far left hangs a giant bronze bell with a wooden striker. To its right, a weeping willow drapes over a koi pond. The player in her red bomber jacket stands centre on white roller skates. Right sits a glowing stone lantern. Far right rise pagoda stairs.
shown: a giant bronze temple bell hanging silently far left
a carved stone lantern glowing with blue fire on the right
steep wooden stairs leading up into a red pagoda far right
